subject: Booking recognition dependencies — Clearwave PO timing & invoicing
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Booking recognition dependencies — Clearwave PO timing & invoicing

Team — quick note to align on Clearwave (deal HB-4821). Procurement reached out asking when we need the PO to start invoicing so they can book/recognize. Key constraints they shared: procurement requires a PO number before they record the commitment, but their legal requires invoice issuance to match services start. They can turn a PO around in ~7–10 business days once we send final SOW/fees.

Questions / asks:
- Finance: will we recognize the booking when we invoice (assuming services start) or only when PO is in hand? Any exceptions for early pro forma invoicing?
- Sales Ops (Marcus): recommend HubSpot stage & best forecast field to use while PO is pending.
- CS (Laura): what does the customer need from our side to confirm services start date?

I attached the PO template they sent (Clearwave_PO_template.pdf) and a draft they promised to share once procurement reviews. Need input today/tomorrow — Clearwave expects cadence updates to close timing for the quarter.

Thanks — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
tessa.morgan@redwood.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booking recognition dependencies — Clearwave PO timing & invoicing

Tessa — thanks for the heads up. Short answer: our revenue recognition rules require either (A) an executed PO/contract that grants the customer the right to the service and an invoice issued per that agreement, or (B) an alternate finance-approved approval (email from authorized buyer + documented acceptance) that allows us to invoice/recognize earlier.

Important details we need to know to advise:
- Effective date the customer wants services to start (service start triggers delivery condition).
- Whether Clearwave's PO will reference our standard MSA or list a different billing cadence/terms.
- Who in their org is the authorized buyer for invoicing (name + email).

Risks: invoicing before PO receipt without documented buyer approval typically blocks recognition until we get the PO. That will push recognized bookings out of the current quarter in our forecast.

If the procurement team can provide an email approval confirming the PO number will follow and authorizing us to invoice on the stated start date, Finance can evaluate on a case-by-case basis — we'll need the buyer's email and procurement lead on the thread.

I'll review the HubSpot deal (HB-4821) and propose a conservative forecast until we have PO or explicit procurement approval.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim, Finance Manager
rachel_kim@redwood.com
From: Sam Benson <sam.benson@clearwave.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Clearwave Procurement <procurement@clearwave.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -04:00
Subject: RE: Booking recognition dependencies — Clearwave PO timing & invoicing

Tessa / Marcus — thanks for the clarity. Procurement update: we expect to issue a formal PO by Fri, Jul 10 (they've prioritized this for the current budget cycle). Our internal policy prefers invoices to be dated on or after the service start date. We can, however, provide an authorized procurement email confirming they will issue the PO and approving the invoice date to match the start date (they can send that today if needed).

Attached is a draft PO we circulated internally (Clearwave_PO_draft_20260702.pdf). Please confirm if an emailed authorization from procurement will be sufficient for Redwood to invoice on the start date, and whether you need anything else (signed SOW, billing contact form).

Appreciate quick confirmation — Sam
Sam Benson
Sr. Procurement Manager, Clearwave Health
sam.benson@clearwave.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Benson <sam.benson@clearwave.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Booking recognition dependencies — Clearwave PO timing & invoicing

Sam — thanks for the draft and the quick turnaround. Good to know PO target is July 10. Rachel — given procurement can email an authorization, would Finance accept that as sufficient to invoice on the planned start date so the customer can reflect commitment?

Suggested path to keep the forecast stable for the quarter:
- Redwood issues a pro forma invoice dated on the service start date (to support the customer internal approvals).
- Final invoice issued once the PO number is received or when procurement email approval is recorded in Finance.
- Finance confirms if pro forma + procurement email is enough for recognition; if not, we leave HubSpot in Commit - PO Pending and mark forecast as Pending PO.

Marcus — can you update HB-4821 stage to "Commit - PO Pending" and set the forecast close date to Jul 10 for now? Laura — can we confirm the customer's warranted start date with CS so we don't prematurely invoice?

Attaching Sam's draft PO for your review.

Thanks — Tessa
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Sam Benson <sam.benson@clearwave.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Booking recognition dependencies — Clearwave PO timing & invoicing

Folks — after quick review with accounting: procurement email approval from an authorized buyer + pro forma is an acceptable path to invoice and recognize bookings provided all of the following are captured and retained by Finance:
- Explicit procurement email that names the PO owner and confirms the PO will be issued by the date in question.
- Clear statement of the service start date and that the customer accepts invoicing tied to that date.
- Copy of the final PO when it arrives to reconcile.

If those items are attached to the HubSpot deal (or emailed to finance@redwood.com cc'ing the buyer), we can recognize the booking for forecast purposes this quarter. If any of those items are missing, we must classify the deal as "Commit - PO Pending" and defer recognition.

Action items:
- Tessa: please request procurement send the authorization email to finance@redwood.com and cc the buyer.
- Marcus: set HB-4821 stage to Commit - PO Pending and put a note referencing this thread; update forecast close date to 2026-07-10 but mark as "recognition contingent on PO email".
- Laura: confirm with Clearwave CS the agreed service start date so Tessa can reference it in the procurement email.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if we need faster sign-off.

— Rachel
Rachel Kim, Finance Manager
rachel_kim@redwood.com
